reason: sync_group_assignee_outbound always puts an "assignment_source_dict" key in the task kwargs, even when it is None (src/sentry/integrations/utils/sync.py:136-145). A worker still running the old `sync_assignee_outbound(external_issue_id, user_id, assign)` signature will therefore raise TypeError. However, the @retry wrapper catches that error and requeues the task up to 5 times, 5 minutes apart (src/sentry/tasks/base.py:163-172; sync_assignee_outbound.py:18-22), so the sync is lost only if every retry also lands on an old worker. Usually it is just delayed.
